highlights.description: The pivot: a new Go CLI + web dashboard (`visionstudio`) for cross-repository roadmap execution — Programs -> Initiatives -> Phases -> RMIs, backed by Dolt — alongside the existing spec-authoring system, superseding the Electron desktop app and cmd/daemon as the primary surface
Renamed the binary and module entry point from `vistudio` to `visionstudio` (breaking)
One-command startup (`visionstudio app start`), an embedded web SPA (go:embed, no external files needed), and actionable DB-down diagnostics instead of raw driver errors
Programs, initiatives, and now individual initiatives can each be hidden from the dashboard, with hiding a program cascading to its initiatives everywhere they're listed

Real path-traversal fixes, not just lint suppressions: the spec-files endpoint and 12 separate CodeQL alerts across cmd/daemon, closed using a validation pattern upstreamed to the shared grokify/mogo library (ValidatePathComponent/JoinSecure/FindFirstExistingSecure) rather than duplicated locally

Full documentation overhaul: README/installation/quickstart now lead with the visionstudio CLI, the Electron/daemon path is explicitly marked legacy, and six new dashboard user-guide pages cover every panel

added.description: pkg/ir: execution type aliases and JSON Schema generation scaffolding the whole roadmap-execution data model
Ent/store/service layers migrated in from prism-build, backed by Dolt (MySQL-compatible, Git-like versioned database)
webapi JSON API and a visionstudio CLI for database orchestration
web/: Vite + React SPA scaffold with a shared UI toolkit and chart primitives
Execution, Spend, Maturity, Specs, and composed four-quadrant InitiativeView panels
End-to-end spec workflow system: workflow selection at initiative creation, judge-result ingestion from disk, agent eval definitions
Spec-files feature: browse and view an initiative's spec documents from the dashboard
pkg/apitypes Go-first type pipeline (Go structs -> JSON Schema -> Zod -> TypeScript) plus Repositories and Performance dashboard panels
`visionstudio app start/status/stop`, `visionstudio ui`, and `visionstudio db` lifecycle commands for one-command startup; embedded web SPA via go:embed
DB-down diagnostics that explain how to fix a connection failure (start the database, run migrations) instead of surfacing a raw driver error
`visionstudio initiative hide/show <id>`, mirroring the existing `program hide/show`, with cascading visibility filtering across every dashboard surface that lists initiatives
Six new dashboard user-guide pages (Tour, Programs/Initiatives/RMIs, Repositories, Specs & Evaluation, Maturity, Performance), verified against the actual routed components rather than guessed

changed.description: Renamed the binary and command from `vistudio` to `visionstudio`
JudgeResult now stores the full structured-evaluation report (Ent schema change)
README, CLAUDE.md, and getting-started docs rewritten to lead with the visionstudio CLI/dashboard; the Electron desktop app and cmd/daemon explicitly marked legacy and not under active development

fixed.description: spec-files endpoint accepted an unvalidated initiative ID straight into a filesystem path; added allowlist validation plus an explicit containment check at each sink

12 separate CodeQL go/path-injection alerts across cmd/daemon (capability, v2mom, spec, maturity, sample, devx handlers) closed using ValidatePathComponent/JoinSecure from the upstreamed mogo library; two of the affected handlers had no prior validation at all
Spec file writes used 0644 permissions (world/group readable); tightened to 0600
Initiative workflow diagram's average-score badge used a stale 0-10 scale threshold while the individual score boxes next to it correctly used the real 1-5 scale

Maturity's Capability Models view didn't fetch execution data, so its initiative filter chips, radar chart, dimension averages, and assessments table all showed hidden-initiative data regardless of hidden status
Phase ordering, empty specType guard, legacy 0-100 score clamping, 3/5 scored as conditional not pass, Windows path/signal compatibility, embedded-Dolt default root, clickable header nav-home

security.description: Upstreamed ValidatePathComponent (allowlist regex) and JoinSecure (filepath.Rel/filepath.IsAbs containment check) to github.com/grokify/mogo's os/osutil, rather than a repo-local package -- verified against a live CodeQL scan that this specific idiom is what the go/path-injection query recognizes as a sanitizer, unlike a strings.HasPrefix check wrapped in a helper function

highlights.description: Extension system: ExtensionManifest/ExtensionContributions types, an ExtensionRegistry distinguishing builtin from marketplace extensions, activation events, and an ExtensionManagerView for browsing/installing
Existing views (VisionSpec, AIDLC, V2MOM, Analytics, unified dashboard) migrated onto the extension system as builtin extensions, not special-cased
Shared UI toolkit — eleven reusable components backing an AppContext-based refactor of the existing views
API Style Spec: a new daemon endpoint plus a full marketplace extension for linting API specifications
DevX period reports: browse historical weekly/monthly/quarterly dashboards, not just the latest snapshot, with two new chart types (pie, stacked bar)

Period selector dropdown (weekly/monthly/quarterly) and `PieChart`/`BarChart` renderers, with `ChartWidget` now dispatching by mark geometry
Shared toolkit component library: DimensionBar, EmptyState, ErrorState, IssueCard, LoadingState, QualityBadge, ScoreBadge, SeverityBadge, StatusBadge, SummaryCard, ViewHeader
Extension system: ExtensionManifest type, extension registry (builtin + marketplace), AppContext for global state, ExtensionManagerView for browsing/installing, marketplace directory structure

highlights.description: DevX usage dashboard: a new, not-project-scoped sidebar view rendering AI-assisted development activity (sessions, prompts, commits, tool usage, cost) sourced from the OmniDevX ecosystem
Read-only, disclosure-scoped boundary — the daemon never queries the OmniDevX event store, only passes through an already-generated, already-decided-safe dashboard file
visionspec upgraded to v0.14.0 — rubrics now use structured-evaluation's shared RubricSet everywhere, one type across the ecosystem

added.description: `GET /api/devx/dashboard`: passthrough handler serving `~/.plexusone/omnidevx/dashboard.json` as-is, with a 404 pointing at the generating command when the file doesn't exist yet
`DevXDashboardView` + a dependency-free renderer for the subset of dashforge's `dashboardir.Dashboard` schema devfolio's exporter emits: metric tiles, line charts with hover tooltips, and tables
`api.getDevXDashboard()`, surfacing the daemon's not-found error message (with the generating command) rather than a generic HTTP status
DevX sidebar section ("Usage Dashboard") alongside Organization — both person/machine-scoped views independent of the active tracked project

dependencies.description: Upgrade `github.com/ProductBuildersHQ/visionspec` to v0.14.0 (was v0.13.0). Breaking change upstream: `pkg/rubrics` drops its VisionSpec-local `RubricSet`/`Category`/`CategoricalCriteria` types in favor of `structured-evaluation/rubric.RubricSet`, and legacy flat rubric YAML is no longer parsed. VisionStudio doesn't import `pkg/rubrics` directly and ships no custom rubric YAML, so this required no code changes — verified with go vet, golangci-lint, and a live daemon run against the profiles endpoint

Transitively bumps `github.com/plexusone/structured-evaluation` to v0.10.0 (was v0.9.0) and adds `github.com/grokify/prism-roadmap` v0.16.0, which visionspec profiles now consume canonical canvas templates and rubrics from
